facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: pressure release during routine operation on TK-4210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on TK-4210 and LT-4210 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on TK-4210 and LT-4210 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically replacing seals and seal support fluid. TK-4210 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during routine operation while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 29 April 2022 an incident occurred on TK-4210 and LT-4210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
